scientific.integrity: The CIR identification is direct from the source equation after substituting constant equilibrium controls. Primary square-root-diffusion literature was inspected for the transition and stationary laws. A standalone checker replays the source parameters and stationary quantiles. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding corrects the state-distribution bands and does not alter the equilibrium effort formulas or the source's first two moments. The displayed exact numerical interval is for the Nash benchmark at stationarity; other game regimes require their own value of A. Gaussian approximation may be numerically adequate at large Gamma shape, but it is not the exact law.

title: The open-data square-root diffusion has exact CIR bands, not the published normal-variance bands
